firstPlayerRule: There is no first player: every round is played simultaneously. Three Construction cards are flipped, then all players choose a Number-Action combination at the same time and use it on their own sheet.
clarifications: Several players may use the same Number-Action combination in the same round.
The rulebook does not assign the card-flipping job to a particular player.

sources.title: Welcome To... Your Perfect Home — English rulebook
sources.location: Game Round, steps 1 (Flip 3 Construction cards) and 2 (Select a Number-Action combination)

internalEvidence: Downloaded the English rulebook from the Blue Cocker site, https://bluecocker.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/Rulebook-EN.pdf; SHA-256 c0f6a6d8598e32187b6dd80bc7d650ecf47fd6d37e190fae6b70f097a23b1cc5, 20 pages. Page 3: each round flip the first Construction card of the 3 stacks, and 'The game round is simultaneous', with each architect selecting one of the 3 combinations at the same time. The back credits read Blue Cocker 2023; streets, pools, parks and City Plans match Welcome To... BGG 233867. No passage names a player to flip the cards. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-25. Editorial review 2026-09-25: Rechecked the source pages, opening instruction, game identity, and edition.
